m: Oven to 160°C. Stab the lamb all over and rub with crushed garlic, oregano, lemon zest, oil and salt.
Roast covered with a cup of water for 3 hours until it pulls apart.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes whole for 15 minutes until tender. Drain and cool.
Rest the lamb covered. Turn the oven to 220°C. Smash the potatoes flat on an oiled tray, oil and salt the tops, roast 30 minutes until crispy.
Mint yoghurt: yoghurt, chopped mint, lemon juice and salt. Salad: lettuce and cucumber with lemon and oil.
Shred the lamb and serve with everything.
l: Lamb, potatoes and salad in one container, yoghurt on the side.
